summary: Read a product page before buying
description: A tool is bought on its specification as much as its price. The product page is where that decision is made, so everything needed to make it has to be on that one page.
acceptanceCriteria: The product page shows the product name as its main heading.
The product page shows the price to two decimal places.
The product page shows the product description.
The product page lists the product specifications as rows of name and value.
The product page offers related products under a heading reading "Related products".
